name: Comprehensive Power Ranking
author: KentJ
description:
Adds a standalone comprehensive national power ranking to WorldBox, scoring each civilization by military, economy, population, territory, city development and national influence using a weighted geometric mean. Press F8 to open.

为 WorldBox 新增一个综合国力排行榜，综合评估每个文明国家的军事实力、经济、人口、领土、城市发展、国家影响力。按 F8 打开。
